# Asem Sharif

> AI & Computer Vision Engineer and PyQt Developer based in Cairo, Egypt. Builds full-pipeline computer vision systems and the interfaces around them, delivering AI solutions with real-time inference through production-grade desktop applications.

## About
Recent AI Graduate, passionate about Computer Vision broadly (Detection, Classification, Segmentation), with particular focus on Human-Centered Tasks and Biometric Technologies, alongside adjacent domains such as Autonomous Systems, Industrial Inspection, and Satellite Imagery.

Believes in the critical importance of the lower-level stages of a project, and frequently builds internal tools and annotation pipelines to support the infrastructure that model development ultimately depends on. This reflects a background at the intersection of Deep Learning and Software Engineering, building production-ready systems (desktop applications, interactive websites) beyond just training models.

- Role: AI & Computer Vision Engineer, PyQt Developer
- Location: Cairo, Egypt (Africa/Cairo)
- Site assistant: 'Twin' — An in-portfolio digital assistant that answers questions about Asem's projects, skillsets, and system architecture
